navigationSource.warning: Archive contains later changes; selected mask writes are corroborated in the pinned original3.58f binary.

analysis: Ordinary bounded LLVM disassembly and pinned archive inspection; no Windows execution or external binary upload. Earlier REA evidence remains retained, with Hopper bridge unavailable.

observations.fact: TR:P queries inverted blocked bit0x01 through Apply; zero sets the blocked bit, any nonzero result clears it.
TR:E similarly reads/writes the inverted entrance-disable bit0x10 independently of the blocked bit.

implementation: Source terrain mutations use actual native tile block/visit masks, preserve suspended object IDs, retain appearance and permit later restoration. Moving native heroes temporarily occupy the scripted cell without restoring its suspended background objects.
Native object/source lookup can still find an entrance-suppressed object; removed or moved objects are not resurrected on restoration. Guard zones and client paths are recomputed after mask changes.
New save feature905 serializes forced masks and suspended object IDs. Versions901..904 initialize the added fields to their ordinary defaults.
limitations: Native proof covers an empty forced-blocked cell, an existing resource and a monster whose entry is disabled; it does not establish every object class or original quest.
TR:T/G/V and logical plot-object retyping remain unadmitted. Connecting synthetic entrances on decorative/non-visitable cells still requires the original plot-object dispatch.
No original Windows random sequence or execution equivalence is claimed. Campaigns remain disabled until their complete quests, combats and victories are validated.
